messages.subject: Re: iplots/JGR error
messages.body_plain:
On Dec 30, 2007, at 10:59 PM, Jean Chang wrote:

> Hi,
>
> I'm attempting to install JGR on a 64-bit system running OpenSuSE  
> 10.1. iplots and JGR seems to install but loading iplots results in  
> an error that prevents JGR from working.
>
> Any suggestions?
>

It has been discussed on this list quite a few times - your Java is  
way too old and buggy (see the error). 64-bit Linux systems need more  
recent Java.

Cheers,
Simon
